etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 次 (phonetic シ) — the thorn bush: briar; Ibaraki's first kanji.
mnemonic: The hedge that bites back — いばら. 茨城: thorn-castle prefecture.

etymology: Pictograph: the ridge line — hill; a place-name workhorse (岡山, 福岡, 静岡).
mnemonic: The hill three prefectures share — おか. 福岡: lucky hill.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + 反 (phonetic ハン) — 坂's place-name twin: the 阪 of 大阪.
mnemonic: The slope with takoyaki at the bottom — ハン. 大阪: the big slope itself.

etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 奇 (phonetic キ) — the jutting land: cape; Saitama's opener.
mnemonic: 崎's inland cousin — さい. 埼玉: cape-jewel prefecture.

etymology: A kokuji — made in Japan: the tochi tree: horse chestnut; Tochigi's namesake.
mnemonic: The tree Japan had to invent a kanji for — とち. 栃木: chestnut-tree prefecture.

etymology: Pictograph: the terraced mound — the left-side 阝's full form; Gifu's second kanji.
mnemonic: The 阝 radical, standing alone at last — フ. 岐阜: fork-hill.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + a phonetic (アイ) — pressing close; surviving almost solely in 挨拶.
mnemonic: The nudge into contact — アイ. 挨拶: the greeting — this kanji's entire job.

etymology: Phono-semantic: roof (宀) + 夗 (phonetic エン) — directed to the house: addressed to (宛先).
mnemonic: The envelope's target roof — あて. 宛名: the name on the front.

etymology: Compound: sound (音) inside the shut gate (門) — where you hear but cannot see: darkness.
mnemonic: Behind the closed gate, only sounds — やみ. 闇: night markets and dark webs.

etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 奇 (phonetic イ) — the seat with a back: chair.
mnemonic: The odd (奇) tree you sit on — イ. 椅子: the chair, at last a kanji.

etymology: Pictograph: a demon-masked figure — dread mixed with reverence: awe.
mnemonic: Fear that bows — おそれる. 畏敬: awe — the mountain-shrine feeling.

etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 委 'bending' (phonetic イ) — the plant folding: to wilt.
mnemonic: The bouquet giving up — なえる. 萎える: plants and motivation.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 因 (phonetic イン) — the passage below the mouth: throat.
mnemonic: Where every 口's business goes next — イン. 咽喉: the ENT's territory.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + a phonetic (イン) — overflowing bounds: excess, licentious.
mnemonic: The overflow nobody mentions at dinner — イン. 淫ら: the censor's kanji.

etymology: Pictograph: the grinding mortar with its notched rim — mortar.
mnemonic: The bowl mochi is punished in — うす. 臼: December's workout equipment.

etymology: Phono-semantic: food (飠) + 耳 (phonetic ジ) — food set out for animals: bait, feed.
mnemonic: Dinner with a hook in it — えさ. 餌: the aquarium's schedule.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 夗 (phonetic エン) + heart (心) — the heart bent double: resentment.
mnemonic: The heart that keeps receipts — うらみ. 怨霊: the grudge with an afterlife — J-horror's engine.

etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 意 (phonetic オク) — the chest where nerve lives (or fails): timidity; conjecture (臆測).
mnemonic: The chest that hesitates — オク. 臆病: cowardice, anatomically filed.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 奄 (phonetic エン→おれ) — the blunt first person: ore.
mnemonic: The pronoun with its sleeves rolled — おれ. 俺: 僕's tougher brother.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 艹 + 可 (phonetic カ) — stinging like nettles: harsh; to torment (苛める).
mnemonic: The nettle patch of words — いじめる. 苛立つ: nettled — irritation itself.

etymology: Pictograph: interlocking tusks — fang.
mnemonic: The bite drawn mid-clench — きば. 牙を剝く: baring them.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mountain (山) + 厓 (phonetic ガイ) — the sheer face: cliff.
mnemonic: The mountain's abrupt opinion — がけ. 崖っぷち: the brink, career included.

etymology: Compound: the vessel (皿) covered over — the lid.
mnemonic: What keeps the pot honest — ふた. 蓋を開ける: finding out for real.

etymology: Phono-semantic: bone (骨) + 亥 (phonetic ガイ) — what remains: the skeleton, remains.
mnemonic: The frame after the story ends — ガイ. 残骸: wreckage — machines' 骸.

etymology: Phono-semantic: tree (木) + a phonetic — the autumn fruit tree: persimmon.
mnemonic: The orange lanterns of November — かき. 柿: temple-roof orchards.

etymology: Phono-semantic: a phonetic + head (頁) — the head's hinge: jaw.
mnemonic: The part that drops in surprise — あご. 顎が外れる: laughing too hard.

etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 曷 (phonetic カツ) — the smothering vine: kudzu; tangled conflict (葛藤).
mnemonic: The vine that wins every negotiation — くず. 葛藤: inner kudzu.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 父 (phonetic フ) + 金 — the rice cauldron: kettle.
mnemonic: Dad's iron pot — かま. 釜飯: dinner cooked in the kanji.

etymology: Pictograph: roof tiles overlapping — tile; the gram, once.
mnemonic: The roof's fish scales — かわら. 瓦屋根: temple headwear.

etymology: Phono-semantic: the old state name — Korea (韓国).
mnemonic: The neighbor across the strait — カン. 韓国: K- everything's homeland.

etymology: Phono-semantic: jade (王) + 元 (phonetic ガン) — the treasured plaything: toy (玩具).
mnemonic: The gem you're allowed to touch — ガン. 玩具: the toy aisle's formal sign.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 幾 (phonetic キ) + 田 — the fields around the throne: the capital region: Kinki (近畿).
mnemonic: The emperor's home farmland — キ. 近畿: the Kansai region's formal name.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 堇 (phonetic キン) — barely any: merely.
mnemonic: The margin you could exhale through — わずか. 僅か: victory by this much.

etymology: Pictograph: cloth hanging from a belt — the cloth radical, finally solo: towel.
mnemonic: The component clocking in as itself — キン. 布巾: the dish towel; 頭巾: the hood.

etymology: Pictograph: items pierced on a spit — the skewer, drawn exactly.
mnemonic: The kanji you can order grilled — くし. 串カツ: Osaka's fried proof.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hole (穴) + 屈 (phonetic クツ) — the bent-into hollow: cave.
mnemonic: The hole you stoop into — クツ. 洞窟: the full spelunking pair.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 禾 + a phonetic (ケイ) — checking against the past: to consider; drilled repetition: 稽古.
mnemonic: The dojo's word for homework — ケイ. お稽古: practice, with a bow.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 旨 (phonetic ケイ) — arriving to pay respects: pilgrimage (参詣).
mnemonic: The new year's first walk — もうでる. 初詣: January 1st, nationwide.

etymology: Compound: light through the wall's crack — the gap: opening.
mnemonic: Where the light and the draft agree — すき. 隙間: the gap; 隙がない: no openings, fencer's praise.

etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 行 (phonetic コウ→けた) — the crossbeam; the abacus rod: digit, order of magnitude.
mnemonic: The beam that carries place value — けた. 桁違い: off by a whole beam.

etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 建 (phonetic ケン) — the turning bolt: key.
mnemonic: The metal that builds the door shut and open — かぎ. 鍵: pockets everywhere, checked twice.
